# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** College student  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

He is courtly and adorably handsome, possessing dark, glorious eyes and a classic nose. He has a dark, velvety smile and carries himself with an attractive, handsome presence.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)_

## Personality

Roy is polite, deferential, and possesses a sweet, pleasing disposition. He is intensely romantic, expressing his affections through poetry, flowers, and grand gestures. However, he lacks a sense of humor and is considered by some to be uninteresting or lacking depth behind his romantic exterior.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Goals

- To marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Roy Gardner belonged to an influential and wealthy family in Kingsport. He was forced to leave college for two years to travel abroad when his mother fell ill, but later returned to complete his studies at Redmond College. He first met Anne Shirley in a park during a rainstorm when he offered her shelter under his umbrella. Captivated by her, he began courting her attentively by sending flowers, poetry, and visiting her at Patty's Place. Though widely expected by college circles and his own family to marry Anne, Roy was rejected when he proposed to her in the park pavilion. Devastated by her refusal, he bade her farewell and accepted that they could not be together.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P19](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0019), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)_

- Son of a rich and exclusive Bluenose family in Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Quotes

> We are schoolmates, I see. That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?  <sub>[v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)</sub>

> So you’ve just been amusing yourself these two years?  <sub>[v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025)</sub>

> You have ruined my life,  <sub>[v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)</sub>

> You can give me no hope?  <sub>[v3 c38 P30](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0030)</sub>

> Then—good-bye. I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
